name: Onehub
description_en:
Onehub is a hosted file-sharing service organized around role-controlled Workspaces, with client portals and a separate virtual data-room mode. It provides file versions, secure links, activity records and export options, each with its own permission or plan conditions. Data-room mode changes collaboration and user visibility, so it should be evaluated separately from an ordinary shared Workspace.

Selection depends on who can access each item, whether a guest link identifies its reader and which users become billable. An elevated Workspace role cannot simply be narrowed by assigning a lower item role, and a viewer with access across several Workspaces may count as a paid user. The reviewed public support and subscription terms also leave billing and cancellation differences that require an applicable order; no account or file operation was performed.
description_zh:
Onehub 是围绕按角色控制的 Workspace 工作区组织的托管文件共享服务，提供客户门户及独立虚拟资料室模式。文件版本、安全链接、活动记录和导出各有权限或套餐条件；资料室模式改变协作方式和用户可见范围，应与普通共享工作区分别评估。

选型取决于谁能访问每项内容、访客链接能否识别阅读者，以及哪些用户会计费。较高工作区角色不能简单通过较低项目角色缩小，跨多个工作区的只读用户也可能成为付费用户。已读公开支持文档与订阅条款还存在计费及取消差异，需依适用订单确认；本研究未操作账户或文件。

sections.title_en: Separate a client portal from a data room
sections.title_zh: 区分客户门户与资料室
sections.en:
Onehub’s hosted service organizes sharing in Workspaces. Data Room mode is offered on Data Room and Enterprise editions. In that mode, Administrators and Moderators can see users/activity while collaboration features such as Dashboard, Activity, Tasks and Commenting are disabled for the anonymous collaboration experience. Anonymity is not anonymity from the service administrators.

For an editorial pilot, create a plan for a fictional acquisition packet: public overview, restricted financial model and draft agreement. Decide whether reviewers should discuss documents with each other or remain hidden from each other. Choose the mode before designing a comment or task-based review process; a portal demonstration does not prove that process works in Data Room mode. This is a proposed evaluation, not a created Workspace or real transaction.
sections.zh:
Onehub 的托管服务以工作区组织共享，Data Room 和 Enterprise 版本提供资料室模式。该模式下管理员和 Moderator 可见用户活动，而匿名协作体验关闭 Dashboard、Activity、Tasks 和 Commenting 等协作功能。匿名不表示对服务管理员匿名。

建议试点先规划虚构收购资料包：公开概述、受限财务模型及协议草案，明确复核者应相互讨论还是互相隐藏，再选择模式。客户门户演示不能证明评论或任务复核在资料室模式也成立。这是建议评估，未创建工作区或执行真实交易。

sections.title_en: Scope invitations before choosing a role
sections.title_zh: 选择角色前先确定邀请范围
sections.en:
Viewer permits preview without printing/downloading; Creator also uploads, comments and manages items they created. Account-level roles reach every Workspace. Workspace Collaborators, Moderators and Administrators cannot be restricted at an individual folder/file. Direct-file invitees cannot use Edit regardless of role; a default item role does not change directly invited users.

For the restricted model, list every access path: Account, Workspace, direct folder/file and guest link. Give external reviewers only the needed scope and inspect the actual Share list. A lower role on one file is not a safe plan for narrowing an elevated Workspace role. Hidden-by-default and Access Denied should be checked against direct invitations and existing elevated membership. The role-preview control is useful for an initial check, but the synthetic plan should also cover a separate ordinary identity. No invitation, hiding, denial or role change was performed.
sections.zh:
Viewer 可预览但不能打印下载；Creator 还可上传、评论并管理自己创建的项目。账户级角色可访问全部工作区。工作区 Collaborator、Moderator 和管理员不能在单个文件夹文件层收窄权限；直接邀请至文件的用户无论角色均不能使用 Edit，项目默认角色也不改变直接邀请用户。

对受限模型需列出账户、工作区、直接文件夹文件及访客链接所有路径，外部复核者仅给所需范围并检查实际 Share 列表。单文件低角色不能安全收窄高权限工作区角色；默认隐藏和拒绝访问需结合直接邀请及已有高权限成员核对。角色预览可初查，但模拟方案仍应覆盖独立普通身份。本研究未邀请、隐藏、拒绝或改角色。

sections.title_en: A Secure Link does not identify its reader
sections.title_zh: Secure Link 不确立阅读者身份
sections.en:
Secure Links allow access without a Onehub account. Activity is attributed to a Guest User and IP address; support cannot identify a person from that IP. Standard defaults permit download, view and print; Advanced and above add configurable link controls. Regenerating a link expires the old URL and resets its settings to defaults.

For the fictional agreement, choose named membership if the decision requires knowing which reviewer received it. If a guest link is appropriate, inspect the resulting role, expiry and password before distribution, especially after regeneration. Disabling a link cannot retrieve a copy already downloaded. A watermark may support attribution but does not prove that copying is technically impossible. No link was enabled, regenerated, distributed or accessed through guest credentials.
sections.zh:
Secure Link 无需 Onehub 账户，活动归于 Guest User 和 IP 地址，支持人员不能仅凭 IP 确认个人。Standard 默认允许下载、查看及打印，Advanced 及以上增加可配置链接控制。重新生成会使旧 URL 失效并将设置重置为默认。

模拟协议若需确认接收复核者身份，应选择实名成员；使用访客链接时，分发前需检查最终角色、到期及密码，特别是重新生成之后。停用链接无法收回已下载副本。水印可辅助归因，但不证明技术上不能复制。本研究未启用、重建、分发或通过访客凭证访问链接。

sections.title_en: Version retention and deletion recovery are different
sections.title_zh: 版本保留不同于删除恢复
sections.en:
Workspaces retain the last ten versions by default, adjustable by an administrator; older versions can also be individually or collectively deleted. Accidental file/folder/Workspace deletion has a support-assisted 30-day recovery window, may take up to 24 hours and requires re-inviting prior users afterward. Automatic deletion is excluded.

The Advanced-plus automatic-deletion setting measures existing files from their original upload dates, not from the day the setting is enabled, and support cannot recover those deletions. Before enabling such a rule, inventory old files and establish a separate preserved copy where required. In the synthetic packet, distinguish restoring an earlier agreement version, recovering an accidentally deleted file and restoring a cancelled account. None is demonstrated by the others. Exact recovery of deleted historical versions and full tenant recovery remain unverified; no deletion, restore or retention setting was operated.
sections.zh:
工作区默认保留最近十版，管理员可调整；旧版也可单独或全部删除。误删文件、文件夹或工作区可在三十天内请求支持协助恢复，可能需二十四小时，恢复后需重新邀请原用户；自动删除不适用该恢复。

Advanced 及以上的自动删除按已有文件原上传日期计算，并非从开启设置当天重新计时，支持无法恢复。开启前应盘点旧文件并按需要另行保留副本。模拟资料包应区分恢复协议旧版、找回误删文件及恢复取消账户，三者不能互相证明。已删历史版本及完整租户恢复未核实，本研究未删除、恢复或改保留设置。

sections.title_en: An index export is not the document archive
sections.title_zh: 索引导出不是文档归档副本
sections.en:
Advanced, Data Room and Enterprise provide a file Audit Trail with views, downloads, new versions and task decisions; permitted elevated roles can inspect it. Advanced-plus Workspace exports distinguish a hierarchy/index export from administrator-only metadata containing attributes such as uploader and Secure Link status. Users invited only to individual folders/files cannot use those Workspace exports.

For the synthetic agreement, reconcile the file content and intended version with its index entry, metadata and decision evidence. An emailed spreadsheet is not proof that binaries, previous versions, comments, permissions or audit history are all included. Ask for a sample exit package and a way to validate it before committing to a real transaction. No export, email, archive or support request was initiated.
sections.zh:
Advanced、Data Room 和 Enterprise 提供文件 Audit Trail，包含查看、下载、新版及任务决定，由有权高角色查看。Advanced 及以上工作区导出区分层级索引与管理员专属元数据，后者含上传者及 Secure Link 状态等属性；仅获邀单个文件夹文件者不能使用这些工作区导出。

模拟协议需把文件内容及目标版本与索引、元数据和决定证据对应。电子邮件中的表格不证明包含原文件、旧版、评论、权限或审计历史。真实交易前应索取退出样包及验证办法。本研究未发起导出、邮件、归档或支持请求。

sections.title_en: Count access scope as well as paid roles
sections.title_zh: 计费同时看访问范围与角色
sections.en:
The current pricing page shows Standard $15/$12.50 per user-month with a three-paid-user minimum, Advanced $25/$20 with five, and Data Room $375/$300 per month, alongside monthly/annual choices. The annual-labelled Standard base would be 3 × $12.50 × 12 = $450 before tax or extras; this is arithmetic, not a quote. Plans offer a 14-day trial, not established sustained-free use.

Any Account-level user, elevated Workspace user, or user in three or more Workspaces counts as paid. Thus a Viewer spread across three client Workspaces can change the bill without becoming an editor. Total-user limits still apply. Pricing advertises cancellation at any time, but the agreement describes committed nonrefundable terms. Help describes prorated added users while the agreement mentions a full added month. Confirm the applicable order rather than silently resolving those differences. No trial, seat addition or purchase occurred.
sections.zh:
当前价格页在月付年付选择旁显示 Standard 每人月 $15／$12.50、最低三付费用户，Advanced $25／$20、最低五人，Data Room 每月 $375／$300。按标记年付的 Standard 月率计算，三人全年为 3 × $12.50 × 12 = $450，未计税费及附加项；这是算术而非报价。套餐提供十四天试用，未确立持续免费使用。

任何账户级用户、高权限工作区用户或进入至少三个工作区的用户均付费，因此 Viewer 分布三个客户工作区也可能改变账单而未成为编辑者，总用户数限制仍适用。价格页宣传随时取消，协议则规定已承诺费用不可取消退还；帮助描述新增用户按比例收费，协议却提及新增整月。需确认实际订单，不能默默消除差异。本研究未试用、加席或购买。

sections.title_en: Export before cancellation and resolve the applicable terms
sections.title_zh: 取消前导出并确认适用条款
sections.en:
The subscription license restricts modification, redistribution and reverse engineering of the service technology; this is a proprietary hosted service, not a source-code reuse grant. Cancellation help says account administrators cancel at cycle end, when data is deleted irrecoverably; $5/month hibernation applies only to active monthly plans. The agreement separately describes conditional post-termination data delivery and advance nonrenewal notice. Do not assume a guaranteed post-cancellation recovery period.

The DPA frames customer instructions and processor duties, return/deletion subject to legal exceptions, and opt-in notices for subprocessor changes. These documents do not constitute an independent security audit or establish a selected hosting region. Before real files, confirm the order, export content and exit timing, processing route and support obligations. A team requiring self-hosted storage or immutable legal records needs evidence beyond these pages. No account cancellation, hibernation, personal-data transfer or contract acceptance was performed.
sections.zh:
订阅许可限制对服务技术修改、再分发和逆向工程，这是专有托管服务，不是源代码复用授权。取消帮助说明由账户管理员取消，当前账期结束后资料不可恢复地删除；每月 $5 休眠仅适用生效中的月付计划。协议另写有条件的终止后数据交付及提前不续费通知，不能因此承诺取消后的恢复期。

DPA 定义客户指令及处理方义务、受法律例外限制的返还删除，以及需主动订阅的分处理方变更通知。这些文本不构成独立安全审计，也不确立所选托管地区。真实文件使用前需确认订单、导出内容、退出时点、处理路径及支持义务；需要自行托管或不可变法律记录的团队需更多证据。本研究未取消、休眠、传个人资料或接受合同。
